caption: The image shows a round ceramic plate decorated with an intricate monochrome design, likely in shades of blue and white, characteristic of historic transferware. The central scene on the plate depicts a landscape with a bridge crossing over a body of water, identified by the inscription as the "Erie Canal Aqueduct Bridge at Rochester." In the foreground, two human figures stand near the edge of the water, with trees and buildings visible in the background. The outer rim of the plate is adorned with a detailed, repeating floral pattern comprising large blooming flowers and leaves encircling the central image. The composition is symmetrical and densely packed with botanical elements framing the scene in the center.
